# Brief (main session → subagent)

A subagent knows only this brief, its instructions, and what it reads from files.

## Spec
Path to the spec, plus the acceptance criteria for this task:
- `docs/context/current-feature.md`
- [criterion]

## Changed files
Files already changed, or to start from.

## Commands
The exact commands to run.

## Definition of done
What must be true when this task is finished. Also say what not to change.

## Return
The format in `docs/templates/summary.md`, plus anything specific you need back.
